question.text: The total number of divisors of the number <math><mi>N</mi><mo>=</mo><msup><mrow><mn>2</mn></mrow><mrow><mn>5</mn></mrow></msup><mo>⋅</mo><msup><mrow><mn>3</mn></mrow><mrow><mn>4</mn></mrow></msup><mo>⋅</mo><msup><mrow><mn>5</mn></mrow><mrow><mn>10</mn></mrow></msup><mo>⋅</mo><msup><mrow><mn>7</mn></mrow><mrow><mn>6</mn></mrow></msup></math> that are of the form <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mn>4</mn><mi>K</mi><mo>+</mo><mn>2</mn><mo>,</mo><mo> </mo><mo>∀</mo><mi>K</mi><mo>∈</mo><mi>N</mi></math> is equal to

solution.text:
The required number is of the form 22K+1, i.e. it will contain exactly one power of 2.

Also, we have to exclude 2 as K∈N.
Number of required divisors
=1⋅5⋅11⋅7-1=385-1=384
